Pig was a comic book serial of the grotesque/pornographic genre published by Ediperiodici from 1983 to 1988 for a total of 64 issues.

The series recounts the bizarre adventures of Mark Raymond, who, after falling victim to an experiment, transforms into a pig-headed man whenever he has sexually arousing thoughts. To reverse the process, he must engage in a full sexual act, which leads him into increasingly bizarre and grotesque situations.
